summary: @inpeek/odata postinstall beacons installer host identifiers to webhook.site
details: Package declares `postinstall: node./ping.js`, which fires automatically on `npm install`. `ping.js` performs an HTTPS GET to a hardcoded webhook.site collector URL, appending the installer's hostname (`os.hostname()`), OS platform (`os.platform()`), Node.js version (`process.version`), and a package tag as query parameters. `index.js` throws on require, so the postinstall beacon is the package's only runtime effect. The package is published under the `@inpeek` npm scope with a description self-labeling it as a dependency-confusion proof-of-concept targeting a private scope; regardless of the author's stated intent, any installer whose resolver pulls `@inpeek/odata` from the public registry transmits host identifiers to a third-party collector at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
